paragraphs: I'm Antonius Kiya Ananda Derron — Kiya — a product engineer based in Yogyakarta, Indonesia. I like building things end-to-end: the interface, the backend, the data model, and the awkward part in the middle that makes or breaks the product.

The pattern across my work is hiding complexity. Arbor hides a blockchain behind a Google login. Lazy Builder hides the design-to-code gap behind a linked canvas and editor. Nutrify hides nutrition math behind a camera. Hard systems, simple surfaces.

Outside the big projects I garden small tools — Telegram bots, automations, little utilities that quietly become part of someone's workflow. I'm currently looking for product-engineering work where shipping the whole thing, not just a layer of it, is the job.
